The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow blotches and spots. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. Limbs are short and stout; forelimbs show distinct digits. The tail extends towards the upper left, partially out of focus.
